newsitem.title: UK: Sacked Woolwich ceo to work for Direct Line - report.
newsitem.headline: Sacked Woolwich ceo to work for Direct Line - report.

text.p: The sacked chief executive of the Woolwich Building Society, Peter Robinson, is to work as a consultant for Direct Line, the direct insurance business of the Royal Bank of Scotland, press reports said on Wednesday.
He will act as an adviser on strategic development reporting to Peter Wood, founder and chief executive of Direct LIne, the Financial Times newspaper said.

Nobody at Direct Line or the Woolwich could immediately be reached for comment. Robinson, 55, was ousted by the Woolwich, Britain's third largest building society, after a dispute over his use of company facilities.
